visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen view featuring a woman with long, wavy brown hair in a pink shirt on the left and a person with short, curly dark hair in a striped shirt on the right, both standing in front of a green chalkboard. (2) The woman, Vivian, is shown holding a textbook and speaking toward the camera in a classroom setting; she smiles and gestures with her hands while leaning against a desk. (3) A person with short hair, Long-ge, stands holding a baseball bat and a large water pitcher, telling a joke with animated facial expressions and wide hand movements. (4) Vivian returns to the screen, preaching about the importance of English while standing by the chalkboard covered in handwritten notes and drawings. (5) Long-ge is seen again, gesturing with the baseball bat while standing in front of a chalkboard with large handwritten characters, appearing to share a personal achievement. (6) Vivian uses a mobile phone to show a Shopee app screen, then points to grammar rules on the chalkboard before the video transitions into a series of product close-ups for Brita water filters with promotional text overlays.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Vivian has long wavy brown hair, wearing a light pink button-down shirt and grey pants. Long-ge has short, dark, curly hair and wears a blue and white vertical striped shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A typical classroom setting with a large green chalkboard covered in English and science notes, a teacher's desk with books and tablets, and a white clock on the wall. Some scenes show a plain white curtain background during the product demonstration.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy pop BGM starts immediately. A female voice (Vivian) introduces herself with a bright, professional tone. (2) Sudden 'ding' sound effect as text appears. Laughter track SFX plays as a male student-like voice asks a question. (3) Transition to a male voice (Long-ge) telling a joke; pitch is lower but delivery is very animated. A loud cartoon-style 'laughing' sound effect triggers. (4) Vivian returns, speaking at a fast pace about English education with high arousal. A 'whoosh' transition SFX plays. (5) Long-ge speaks again, tone becomes more boastful and narrative. Background music continues at a steady, upbeat 128 BPM. (6) Promotional segment begins with very dense speech and multiple overlapping SFX (pops, dings) corresponding to Shopee and Brita product highlights. The female voice maintains a highly enthusiastic sales-pitch tone throughout the final segment.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Character introduction -> Skit-based archetypes -> Product integration -> Call to action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Shopee's '418 Member Day' and Brita water filter products by using humorous character archetypes (typical cram school teachers) to engage the audience before transitioning into the sales pitch.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names 'Shopee 418 Member Day' and displays the Brita product with its features and promotional pricing.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly produced social media advertisement using 'cram school teacher' memes to target students and parents.
